description: Answers a question about WebinarIgnition itself: what it can do, its limits, integrations, and whether it fits the host's case. The answer comes only from the connector's checked knowledge base. Take it when a host asks about the product, for example "Does this work with my shop?" It needs the question in the host's language, German by default. Nothing is created and no site is touched. When the base holds no matching entry, the answer says so and points to https://webinarignition.com/. Words hosts use: product question, limits, integrations, does it fit

language.description: The language the host writes in.

text.description: What the host said (thema · weiter) or the question in the host's language (frage).

name: wi_answer_product_question
title: Answer a WebinarIgnition question
